title: ForPC: Force-Aware Whole-Body Control for Precise Humanoid Cart Pushing
description:
arXiv:2611.08664v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humanoid robots are expected to take over strenuous material handling in manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare, where operating existing wheeled carts would let them move heavy loads without modifying the workplace.
